runtimeMapping.ordinary: Original RangedAttack CAST0, Arts, one ALL-motion victim, Attack .667 at capped1 ASPD rate, speed8 projectile; clearProjectileWhenDead0 and stopWhenSourceInvalid0 preserve born flight.
runtimeMapping.activeHealing: All selected skills switch mode to one ALL-motion injured HEAL recipient and selected trait heal_scale.75; S1 literal Attack .667, S2 Skill .633, S3 Skill_2_Loop .633, uncapped ASPD. Source mode selector CAST0 reacquires on release, HEAL legality checked at impact, current source ATK used (useCachedAtkOnly0).
runtimeMapping.silentSentinel: Source .1 checker waitFirst0; native HpRatioTrigger uses 1% thresholds with minHp.3, then subtract1 and base*(1+scale*count). Adapter interprets integer missing-HP bins, strongest owned Sanctuary; S3 and token scale only base.
runtimeMapping.plumes: Source .1 waitFirst0 checker with strict HP<.5 creates normal plus Rhine-tag extra one-second delayed nonstacking derived HP-regeneration channels; current sourceATK and final recipient HPregen scaler, no HEAL-free restriction on purpose0 validator.
runtimeMapping.drone: Selected S2 only stock1, cost0/slots0, no facing, ALL tiles, own source-phase stats and x-4 talent; source token config multiplies own talent damage_resistance_base by selected owner damage_resistance_scale. ON_OWNER_FINISH recharges at removal+respawn5, S2 finish explicitly withdraws all then refresh stock0.
runtimeMapping.grave: S3 global battle activation cap2, manual cancel; source LOW_PRIORITY ON_BEFORE_TRY_SET_HP_ZERO interpreted via fatal damage/HPLOSS hook. One source self-marker consumed to add nonderived UNDEADABLE for selected duration; already-undeadable/shield/dodge/scripted removal do not spend. Result survives owner/end/range detachment.

verificationLimits: Original assets and all selected ranks are verified; exact native C# frame/order parity is not claimed.

Native HpRatioTrigger GE internal count/one-based integer dispatch is unrecovered. The adapter uses floor(missingHP/selected.01) capped at selected minimumHP.3, matching official endpoint values; fractional-threshold tests bind this bounded interpretation.

Native numeric selector purpose/motion/postFilter/professionMask dispatch is not recovered. ALL-motion Arts and HEAL selectors use shared current-range CAST legality; purpose0 auras separate healing restriction from buff eligibility; S3 mask639 is bounded to Operator recipients by official description.

Native eventless ApplyBuff waitForAttackEvent1/preDelay0 startup/FSM dispatch is not executable here. Timed active mode applies at command with source begin clip presentation only; no invented clip combat delay.

Native TrySetHpZero modifier/Consume ordering is unrecovered. Shared fatal hook maps mitigated damage and pure HP loss; scripted kill/retreat is excluded, existing UNDEADABLE prevents consumption, born independent grave persists.

Native RechargeToken NORMAL versus ON_FINISH queue dispatch is unrecovered. Explicit source removal recharge is modeled as stock1 with independent5s cooldown; selected skill finish withdraws then clears stock as raw template order specifies.

Derived regen DEFAULT/priorityBB override maps to strongest selected ratio per normal/Rhine channel, preserving owned fallback and delayed1s pulse; native equal-priority source tie order is not claimed.
Unity particle/trail effects are not rendered; existing tracked projectile presentation uses exact source speed instead.
